description: Stops monitoring a profile: no further scheduled refresh crawls are charged for it. Free to call. Pass the internal profileId (from list_tracked_profiles or search results). The profile and its already-crawled posts stay in the database and searchable; only the recurring refresh stops. Returns not_found if the profile is not currently being monitored. Cost: free.

profileId.description: Internal profile id to stop monitoring

name: untrack_profile
title: Stop Monitoring a Profile
